West Bengal is the largest Paddy-producing state | Punjab is known as the granary of wheat
Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Odisha & Karnataka are major producers | Largely grown Punjab, Haryana, Bihar, Rajasthan, Gujarat and Uttar Pradesh

Tea grows well in high altitude -1200 to 2400 metres.

India is famous for Tea export.
